explanation: An empty array needs no work. Normalize a signed right shift into 0 through n-1, reverse the entire array, then reverse the leading shifted block and the remaining block to restore the order within each block.
spaceComplexity: O(1) auxiliary space inside the rotation algorithm; the published judge wrapper makes its required O(n) array copy.
attribution: Original C++ implementation and judge wrapper independently authored for EPI Practice from the displayed rotation contract. No upstream reference implementation adapted. Public EPIJudge interface and test framework retained under the repository LICENSE.
